text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
âFound you!
Gracing us with her presence is... the Goddess of Social Mediaaa!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for being so abrupt!!
However, my fortune told me that 'Today is the day to act!'
IâI just can't let things stay like thisâ

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to die alone on Umastagram~!
Someone save meeee~~!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy! Fukukitaru,
don't be a stranger, c'mon!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If you're having trouble,
we, the Three Musketeers of SNS, are here to help!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The Three Social Media Musketeers!?
Um, and who might these people be...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: They're a super popular influencer on UmaTube and Umatter!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Given what we're discussing,
I thought it'd be best to invite them both too♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So? Your trouble is going viral?
Then first, let's grill up a big steak!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Buzzed?! A steak?! That's far too extravagant!
I just... um."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: —I want to connect with someone~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm.
You mean you want to gain more followers, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yeees... Actually, you see, I tried
making an Umastagram account, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "No matter how much time passes, I still have zero followers! It's always just me on the timeline...!"

text_block_list.name: ＠Funnya_happy
text_block_list.text:
"Today's horoscope result is—Terrible Luck!
Oh no! Share this result with everyone to turn your fortune around♪♪ ↓↓Link↓↓"

text_block_list.name: ＠Funnya_happy
text_block_list.text:
"Today's horoscope result is—Great Blessing!
Awesome! Share this result with everyone to spread the happiness♪♪ ↓↓Link↓↓"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, only fortune results! Perfectly suspicious!
You won't get any followers like this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah!! You had to say it that bluntly?!
Ugh, am I really headed straight for dying alone?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
—HAHHHH!!
I com-pleeeeee-tely understand now!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I shall introduce Fukukitaru-san
on my Umatter!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
An introduction from the Class Rep carries huge weight!
Your follower problem will be Bakushin-solved in no time!
Now then, without further ado—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hyawaaa, spare me from that, please~!!
I really don't like standing out, you see!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Casually connecting with friends,
pressing 'Uma-like' here and there...
That's really all I want to do.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, then Fukukitaru's competitive eating challenge plan is rejected too.
You're surprisingly shy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, is it selfish of me...?
To want to connect with friends without putting in the effort, I mean."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, Umasta isn't something
a person like me should be messing with—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's the other way around! Umasta exists for you, Fukukitaru-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hohe? For me...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to make friends, wanting to talk to someone...
Even if someone finds that hurdle high, all they need is a smartphone to easily clear it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"You're free to post, and free not to.
But if you feel like taking that step...
from that day on, UmaSta is your playground♪"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: A-A goddess...?! Is this the radiance of the UmaStagram Queen...?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And so, Curren's answer is...
let's connect with Bakushin O-san and Taiki-san♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Those two who stood up for your sake,
Fukukitaru-san, are already your friends♪
It's the perfect first step!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You're right! As class rep, I feel like
I did make an UmaSta account, too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I made it together with Suzuka too!
Let's go ask her!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
O... Ooh...! Thanks to the classmate power,
my followers are shooting up in no time...!
The timeline's suddenly so lively!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So this is what it means to be connected...!
Th-This is so fun~~!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that wonderful?♪
Curren's so happy for you too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Um...! May I follow you on social media too, Curren-san!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It might be an impudent request for a Goddess, but...!
S-since you were the other one who stood up for me...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes, let's connect♪
Please follow "@Curren"~♪
